get.description: Returns a paginated list of albums. Each album includes its artist.

artist.description: The artist who made the album.

pagination.description: Where the returned page sits among all pages.

total_items.description: Total number of items across all pages.

prev_page_url.description: Path of the previous page, or null on the first page.

next_page_url.description: Path of the next page, or null on the last page.

400.description: The query is invalid, or the requested page or limit is out of range.

error.message: Invalid input: expected number, received NaN

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Defaults to 10, or the total if fewer.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to return, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.
